criteria.business_model: The startup must sell to businesses and help automate business workflows. Any B2B model is eligible.
criteria.sector: Eligible sectors are Fintech, Legaltech, Logtech, and Proptech.
criteria.geography: The startup must be headquartered in Spain, Italy, Portugal, Mexico, Colombia, Chile, or Peru.
criteria.expansion: Potential to expand between Southern Europe and Latin America is preferred.
criteria.stage: The startup must be at the Pre-Seed or Seed stage, with a working MVP and early signs of traction, such as active users or pilots.
criteria.exclusions: Excluded activities include purely B2C business models, hardware, biotechnology, pure crypto or Web3, gambling, tobacco, and cannabis.
